about.heading: Enduring Value. Modern Execution.
about.description:
We believe the most successful content is built like the world renowned Porsche flat-six engine: well-balanced, incredibly powerful, and engineered for the kind of enduring performance that turns creative vision into measurable, bottom-line success.

Flat Six Media is a boutique consultancy providing executive caliber support across strategy, finance, and operations functions. We work with independent producers, production companies of all sizes, and major studios. We work across film, television, streaming, video games, sports, and live events. We are available for single engagements and ongoing support on retainer.

founder.name: Michael Rifkin
founder.imageAlt: Michael Rifkin, founder and principal of Flat Six Media
paragraphs: Michael is a seasoned media executive with nearly two decades of experience at the intersection of finance, strategy, and global distribution. Before founding Flat Six Media, he served as Co-Head of Sony Pictures International Productions, overseeing finance and operations for a slate of 30+ films annually.

His tenure included senior leadership within Columbia Pictures’ Business Development group, where he was instrumental in the financial modeling and greenlighting of major franchises, including Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, Jumanji, and Hotel Transylvania.

After leaving Sony Pictures, Michael founded Flat Six Media, a boutique consultancy focused on providing premium support to content businesses. The firm offers retained and ad hoc greenlight support for independent and studio feature films, fractional CFO and strategy work, and underwriting support for slate and production-company financing transactions. Michael’s experience in feature films has also led to repeat engagements with the United States government as an expert witness.
Flat Six Media has extensive experience supporting clients across the entertainment industry. We work with each client to customize a solution that works for their business.

footer_cta.heading: What decision is in front of you?
footer_cta.description: Tell us what is at stake, where the uncertainty lies, and what decision needs to be made. We will determine whether Flat Six Media is the right fit and what level of support the situation requires.
